name: Fine
source:
The Homunculus girl whom the protagonist and the others create entirely by accident.

Quiet and easygoing by nature, she's nonetheless wide-eyed and curious about everything around her, with a friendly, guileless charm that quickly wins people over. 

She stays at Ruri's place and helps out at the shop as its mascot and poster girl.

[From [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/kagami-games-to-release-7-visual-novels-including-sakura-moyu/]NookGaming[/url]+Kagami Games' stream]
